Checks the terminal's font.family fallback and wide-glyph centering.

Checks a terminal fix (F192: the workbench sent a background open without an image). The real behavior checked is the terminal drawing shell output. A core part (a hidden tab stays mounted) could move to `plain-view`.
Helper that traces terminal input transactions for terminal-keyboard.test. Keep it with the terminal plugin, or reduce it to a fixture trace.
Checks that native keys edit and execute commands independently in three terminal shells.
Checks that a terminal opened after the earlier terminals closed displays the prompt of its shell.
Checks replay of terminal sessions with sidecar and page frame hashes stored by the terminal plugin. The core replay command could be checked with a fake sidecar fixture.
Helper that opens terminals and reads terminal screen glyphs and pixels, and is used by many core tests. It must be reduced to fixture helpers (open `plain-view`, read the fixture color or echo log).
Checks that the selection highlight follows the pointer while a status line redraws (terminal P105).

Tests section-view discovery, placement, ready status and section drag with made-up `files`/`browser`/`term` manifests in temporary folders. Replace with a sections capability on a fake fixture (for example, plain-view with a declared section, a ready status enum and history).
Tests failure-evidence collection that reads `terminal.pty.pending` and `terminal.ime.trace` from the terminal plugin.
Tests how the terminal's cell screen and backgrounds are read and sampled (wrapped command output, cell rows), which is terminal screen content.

"view content reads the value that holds the shown text of each plugin" -> plugin cohort (browser/editor/hwp/term/terminal), so it should move to each plugin; "terminal content readiness preserves omitted blank cell characters" -> plugin:terminal; "view content refuses a missing, wrong or not presented value" -> core (plain-view with a content-read command); "view pixel crops include the capture content origin and scale once" -> core (capture, any fixture); "view pixel crops reject clipping and incomplete pixel storage" -> core (capture, any fixture)

This helper (not a test) reads the shown content of each real plugin (`browser.content.read`, `editor.read`, hwp page SVG, `term`/`terminal.screen.read`) and builds the cases for those plugins. The per-plugin readers belong to plugin:browser, plugin:editor, plugin:hwp, plugin:term and plugin:terminal; the generic harness is core and should use a plain-view content-read command.
Measurement script whose process attribution names the "browser" and "term" plugins/sidecars of an installed app. It should be reduced to taking plugin ids from the configuration or from fixtures.

"the surface plugins are the installed plugins whose manifest declares a surface" -> core (fake manifests, but it reads plugins/term and plugins/files and should use e2e/fixtures manifests); "the targets of a scenario come from the goals…", "the runs interleave the five applications…", "the sessions of B3 live beside the baseline record…", "the session folder holds the session, the baseline record and the sidecar record…", "the run reads the declarations of the e2e benchmarks…", "the run conditions are read from injected readings…" -> core (measurement harness; fixture data names term/browser and should use view-drag/plain-view ids)
Tests candidate acceptance and publication of release components (`kind: 'plugin', id: 'terminal'` release digests), which is cohort release evidence.

Tests the measurement harness (process attribution, sidecar sums, pointer step), using "term"/"browser" as sample ids. Replace with fixture ids (view-drag, plain-view, sidecar-probe).
